name: Bitcoin Payments
description: Bitcoin QR payment requests plus optional Lightning checkout through a signed adapter.
author: Wabi Core

security.threatNotes: Non-custodial only. Personal Bitcoin QR requests use the sender's saved Bitcoin address. Optional Lightning checkout stays behind operator-controlled adapter configuration or local test mode.

capabilities.notes: Bitcoin-first provider plugin. Lightning remains adapter-backed when enabled.

methods.label: Bitcoin QR
methods.notes: Builds a BIP21 Bitcoin QR from the sender's saved Bitcoin address.

methods.label: Lightning
methods.notes: Lightning checkout requires a configured adapter or local test mode.
